name: 83318 · Burley, ID
findings: ZIP 83318 (Burley) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83318 (Burley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
